definition: The term evolvability is a framework of computational learning introduced by Leslie Valiant in his paper of the same name.
details: The aim of this theory is to model biological evolution and categorize which types of mechanisms are evolvable. Evolution is an extension of PAC learning and learning from statistical queries.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. Boil it down and it is this: The term evolvability is a framework of computational learning introduced by Leslie Valiant in his paper of the same name. Here is why it matters: The aim of this theory is to model biological evolution and categorize which types of mechanisms are evolvable. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Evolvability (computer science).
